bills.summary: Toughens the law against criminal factions and organised crime.
Bars spending freezes on the telecommunications universalisation fund.
Changes unemployment insurance for artisanal fishers during the fishing closure.
Tax reform: replaces several consumption taxes with a VAT-style system.
Votes on stripping a deputy of his mandate for breach of decorum, or a milder penalty.
Creates federal courts in Amazonas and Mato Grosso do Sul.
Creates a national policy of legal assistance for vulnerable crime victims.
Creates a special tax regime for data-centre services (REDATA).
Cuts PIS/Cofins rates for the chemical and petrochemical industry.
Creates a special tax regime for non-profit sports associations.
Approves an international agreement on conservation of migratory species.
Creates a national system against violence towards girls and women, with earmarked funds.
Requires registration of freight transport operations and a transport identification code.
Sets rules on tax benefits and mandatory spending for 2026.
Sets rules on tax benefits and mandatory spending for 2026.
Extends the exemption from the merchant-marine renewal surcharge for coastal shipping.
Makes unjustified price rises on public-utility goods a crime.
Sets rules for tax waivers to soften an international energy-price shock.
Raises the annual revenue limit and staff limit for individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEI).
Chooses a minister of the federal audit court (TCU) by secret vote.
Rewrites the firearms-law article on illegal possession and carrying.
Changes the fiscal framework and related laws to give the Executive new fiscal-management tools.
Regulates recognition, demarcation and use of indigenous lands (marco temporal).
Tax reform: unifies ICMS legislation.
Classifies food adulteration as a heinous crime.
Regulates paternity leave in the labor code.
Regulates automatic toll-payment services under concession law.
Excludes pension contributions from the personnel-spending limit of the fiscal responsibility law.
Creates a national policy to encourage sustainable production and consumption.
Controls animal genetic material and the supply of clones of domestic animals.
Allows fixed-term hiring of young people aged 16 to 24 with reduced employer charges.
Makes enforced disappearance a crime and a heinous crime.
Creates a national policy on conservation and sustainable use of the marine biome.
Creates substitute labour-judge posts at a regional labour court.
Allows the public health system to buy blood derivatives without a tender.
Gives the Union, states and DF concurrent power to legislate on protection of the elderly.

votes.why: Yes shields a public fund from spending freezes.
Tax simplification reform; mixed, mildly pro-business.
Yes prefers a lenient penalty (suspension) over losing the mandate.
Yes adopts the amendment replacing loss of mandate with a milder penalty.
Yes cuts taxes for an industrial sector.
Yes gives a special tax regime to sports associations.
Yes extends a tax exemption for coastal shipping.
Yes widens the simplified regime for micro-entrepreneurs.
Yes favours landholder interests over indigenous land demarcation.
Yes loosens the payroll-spending ceiling for governments.
Yes allows cheaper fixed-term youth contracts (labor flexibilization).
